paragraphs: Welcome to Busarialao College. We began in 2003 as Top Tutors, a small tutorial centre, and opened as a college in 2006 with nine learners and a clear idea: that science should come alive. {yearsInWords} years on, we are a science-focused school where curiosity is nurtured, character is built, and excellence is expected.
From JSS1 to SS3, our laboratories, mentors and clubs help students think like scientists and prepare for WASSCE, NECO and the choices that follow.
Whether your child joins us as a day student or a boarder, they will find a community that expects their best and helps them give it. We would be glad to welcome you on a visit.

vision: To be a leading Centre of academic excellence where young minds are inspired, empowered, and equipped with the knowledge, skills, and character needed to thrive in a rapidly changing world.
mission: To provide a conducive learning environment that promotes quality education and intellectual curiosity.
To nurture students through a balanced blend of strong scientific education, moral guidance, and life-building skills.
To develop critical thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators who can compete globally and contribute meaningfully to national development.
To partner with parents, educators, and the community to shape responsible, confident, and well-rounded individuals.
story: We began in 2003 as Top Tutors, a tutorial centre in a modest two-room apartment at Adewole Estate, Ilorin, where specialist science teachers prepared students for external exams.

In 2006, Alhaji Yunus Ajibola Gafar founded Busarialao College. He was 43, with twenty years in the civil service and a professional accounting qualification. The college is named in honour of his late father. It opened with one block of classrooms, an administrative building, and laboratories for Chemistry, Physics, Biology and Agricultural Science. Our first intake was nine learners and nine staff: the pioneers.
The founder wanted a school where science comes alive: practical, well equipped, with dedicated teachers. His accounting background shaped the school’s discipline, planning and financial management.

The early years were hard. The founder took loans to keep the school running and cut his own spending. It was not easy to find qualified science tutors, or to win the trust of parents in a new school.
Top Tutors remains the college’s academic arm. It sets exam questions (Saturday tests, certification exams and preparatory exams), trains teachers, and runs seminars for staff.
